NONE: A1 used with another verb to form questions and negative sentences, including negative orders, and sometimes in affirmative sentences for reasons of style
（與另一動詞連用構成疑問句和否定句，包括表示禁止的命令，有時因文體原因亦可用於肯定句）
A2 used instead of the main verb in questions that are added to the end of a sentence to check information
（在用來確認資訊的疑問句中代替主要動詞）
› used instead of the main verb in questions that are added to the end of a sentence as a way of expressing surprise
（在表示驚奇的疑問句中代替主要動詞）
B1 used to avoid repeating a verb or verb phrase
（用於避免動詞或動詞片語的重複）

+ infinitive without to: B2 [ + infinitive without to ] used to give extra force to the main verb
